sources.entry: 🧰 decalage2/awesome-security-hardening: security hardening guides, tools and other resources

summary.one_liner: A curated "awesome" list of security hardening guides, benchmarks, checklists, audit and hardening tools, and related resources across operating systems, services, hardware, cloud and more.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link collection rather than software. It organizes hardening guides and best practices by platform and service, including GNU/Linux distributions, Windows, macOS, network devices, IPv6, firewalls, VMware, containers and Kubernetes, SSH, TLS/SSL, web servers, mail, FTP, databases, Active Directory, ADFS, Kerberos, LDAP, DNS, NTP, NFS, CUPS, passwords, hardware/BIOS/UEFI and cloud. A separate Tools section lists checkers (for example Lynis, OpenSCAP, PingCastle, testssl.sh, ssh-audit, CHIPSEC, Docker Bench for Security) and tools that apply hardening (for example DevSec Hardening Framework, Linux Server Hardener, Microsoft Security Compliance Toolkit). It also includes sections on password generators, books, and other awesome security lists. Many entries are government or vendor publications such as NSA, ANSSI, NIST, CIS and DISA, and some are marked as archived, outdated or in French.
use_cases: Finding hardening guides for a specific OS or service
Locating CIS, STIG or ANSSI benchmarks
Auditing a Linux or Windows host's configuration
Checking SSH or TLS server configuration
Discovering other curated security resource lists
notable: Organized by platform and service, with a separate Tools section split into checking tools and applying tools
Includes government and standards-body guidance from NSA, ANSSI, NIST, CIS, DISA and ACSC
Links to other awesome security lists, borrowed from the Awesome Security list
Notes which entries are archived, outdated or require registration
caveats: Link list only; the README does not provide installable software, and the linked resources are not maintained by this repository
Several entries are marked as outdated, archived, or as not covering TLS 1.3
Some linked guides require registration (CIS Benchmarks, CIS Docker Benchmarks) or are in French
